description: SYNTHORA domain-lookalikes: Brand-impersonation radar: finds lookalike domains that are ALREADY registered for your domain (typos, keyboard slips, homoglyphs, hyphens, bitsquatting, phishing suffixes, TLD swaps; up to 450 candidates) and whether they are armed to impersonate you: active mail (MX), resolving, age and registrar (RDAP), parked, or probably your own defensive registration. Ranked high/medium/low with actions, a plain-language plan by our own model (marked as AI) and a self-resolving calibration question. Public DNS (DoH) and RDAP only; lookalikes are never contacted. Ed25519-signe [x402: 0.019 USDC per call on Base]
name: domain_lookalikes
